build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with parameterized segment lengths and angles
create_physics_scene: create a physics scene with static bars, dynamic jars, and balls using the creator API
add_scene_objects: add static bars and dynamic balls to the scene with C.add specifying scale angle and position
update_task_goal: update the task goal by setting body relationships like TOUCHING between a ball and wall
set_solution_metadata: set the solution tier metadata using C.set_meta to classify the puzzle difficulty level
